query: Change the subject and HTML in this Guzli email draft, but do not publish it. The first edit reports a stale lock.
expected_behavior: Reads the draft and uses its step_id and lock_version with guzli:update_campaign_draft_step.
Re-reads and reconciles after the stale lock rather than retrying the old expected_lock_version.
Verifies the saved subject, body_html and independent body_text.
Does not call a publish or run tool.
